Name: Seasonal Leafeon (CP)
Author: wrennybirdy
Description:
Seasonal Leafeon retexture for the cat, inspired by ImXTooNinjaxX's [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1673]Leafeon mod[/url], and using that sprite sheet. The sprite sheet is originally from Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Darkness/Time. Requires Smapi and Content Patcher.

I referenced the last artwork in the images, but I reversed image searched and couldn't find the artist. 

Added an optional orange version for fall!

Please let me know if there are any bugs. I'll try to fix them, but may not be able to because this is my first mod. 
I noticed that sometimes when you leave your house in the morning, your pet is not there, but it reappears when you reenter and exit the house again. I'm not sure how to fix that. If you have an idea of what the problem is, please tell me!

Seasonal Eeveelutions (Sylveon, Leafeon, Flareon, Glaceon) [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3822]Done![/url]

Future plans:
Seasonal Bulbasaur
Seasonal Eevee? With flower crowns? Maybe idk
Feel free to suggest more!
